cases.method: hand-verified (Sean 2026-08-28)
cases.notes: A pocket score: 15.8px line spacing at 600 DPI. The wind staves are printed lightly enough that their lines break into ~25 runs with gaps up to 11 staff spaces, which is why they were missed entirely and why their x-extents are still wrong (see known_gaps).

cases.method: hand-verified (left-margin render, read part by part (Claude, 2026-08-28) — evidence/lamer-p25-margin-21-staves.png)
cases.notes: Counted off the margin: Gdes Fl., Pte Fl., Htb, Cor A., Cl., Bons, Cors x2, Tromp., Tuba, Timb., Cymb., Harpe x2, 1res Vons Div. x2, 2ds Vons Div. x2, Altos, Celli, C.B. — 21 staves in one system. The twelfth is Cymbales, printed as a SINGLE rule. Before one-line staves were detected the page reported 20, and every staff from the harp down carried a staff_index one lower than its true slot — the harm is not the missing percussion part, it is the nine parts under it being mistaken for their neighbours. Measures are not hand-counted here; the page is recorded for its staff layout.
